how: A participant proposes the mark, places an initial pixel, and invites others to improvise from it.
Calls recruit participants for particular marks and later inscription work.
A bare seconding directly accepts the proposed initial placement without requesting anything back.
Participants contest which inscription represents the fandom and propose incompatible ways to retain or replace it.
Participants justify design choices through competing accounts of accessibility, spoilers, and the character's powers.
Contributors report their placing, mistakes, and completion of the outline.
Participants request a pixel template and circulate a location with a target image.
Improvisation and explicit thread coordination coexist with a request for moderators to resolve an unsettled choice.
A participant's disclaimer of organization limits claims about collective authority without negating task coordination.
Competing placers enact incompatible design claims by overwriting and restoring the same inscription.
Posting or endorsing a specification settles the design only if competing placers accept it rather than repeatedly restoring another version.
A rumor about unspecified pieces does not establish that participants operated placement automation.
The record shows repair and a bot rumor without demonstrating adoption of automation to overcome repair pressure.
Repeating a rumor about protective bots is observable explanatory talk distinct from implementing automation.
Participants maintain the figure and label through reported work, persistence checks, and calls for repairs.
Maintenance depends on which version a participant treats as correct because well-intended defense can undo another helper's repair.
A helper identifies an incorrect pixel as their own contribution.
A participant attributes repeated eye reversions to well-meaning defenders without identifying the actual placers.
Blaming a group and correcting its name support reported attribution but establish perpetrator identity only with additional evidence.
Participants invoke an existing neighbour agreement and explicitly request and accept a protective shared border.
Negotiating safe placement can precede completion and explicitly justify remaining at a construction site.
Neighbour talk need not arise from neighbours eroding a finished mark because an existing agreement already supports construction.
A visitor explicitly presents themself as a representative carrying a joint border request.
A respondent conditionally promises to spare the neighbour's logo if the shared figure is left intact.
A qualified individual's commitment cannot establish compliance by every placer or subsequent implementation after placement closes.
A neighbour offers spare pixels while requesting protection and a respondent promises squares for the shared border.
The protective border request receives a conditional promise of restraint rather than evidence of room-wide compliance.
Neighbour negotiation includes offered pixel help without establishing completed reciprocal work.
Offers of neighbour help do not establish that maintenance exhausted local hands and caused outside recruitment.
Reports of contributions from several subreddits do not establish a coalition or shared obligations.
The reported agreement identifies safe space without establishing a host's rule over guest builders.
Disclaiming organization qualifies a border promise without disputing anyone's entitlement to commit the room.
The border request and qualified answer do not demonstrate that an agreement caused a dispute over representative authority.
Fandom language supplies jokes and playful recognition around the shared image.
Participants describe inscription factions through fandom language and argue over lore subreddits' acceptable conduct.
The live inscription conflict and its factions do not establish that the quarrel predates the canvas.
Arguments about a shared image extend into disagreement about which kinds of fun belong in related subreddits.
Neither the proposed encroachment nor the rhetorical war call establishes a prior tie naming the attacked rival.
Calling the event full of memes does not establish a host-specific April Fools takeover or licence.
Requesting moderator arbitration of lettering does not establish host containment or removal of canvas talk.
A recruitment call and request for design arbitration do not establish that a canvas flood caused host containment.
Completion is marked through announcements, thanks, celebration, and in-world drink.
Participants allocate and dispute credit among related subreddits rather than establishing sole room authorship.
Collective celebration establishes attributed participation but exclusive authorship requires evidence beyond shared ownership language.
The record preserves a participant's account that the smaller attempt was covered.
An edited completion announcement links a record of the completed face without settling subsequent inscriptions.
After placement closes a visitor clarifies that the admired art was not their subreddit’s work.
A post-close attribution clarification supports revising the event account without establishing cleanup of a canvas copy.
Post-close lore repetition and subreddit discussion do not show a successor canvas or retained collective purpose.
Completion celebration and linked records do not establish that celebration caused preservation activity.
A completion record and subsequent lore repetition do not establish movement toward a durable next purpose.
A participant proposes placing the mark directly over another game's logo without demonstrating that a coordinated raid occurred.
An exasperated edited comment voices a war call without establishing execution.
A rhetorical war call and criticism of lore subreddits do not establish an ongoing canvas contest against a named rival room.
The mark proposal directly receives a suggestion to place it in the middle of another logo.
The encroachment suggestion receives an enthusiastic template request rather than a recorded refusal or apology.
The later neighbour agreement has no demonstrated response link to the earlier encroachment proposal.
The rhetorical war call has no demonstrated subsequent rival-room contest caused by it.
Maintenance and shared contribution reports do not demonstrate entry into a coalition because of defense pressure.
Proposing a figure and calling for its construction occur together in one starter's appeal.
A helper reports placing pixels before arriving at the thread so subsequent work cannot all be attributed to its recruitment call.
The initial-placement proposal receives a bare seconding as its direct reply.
Completion reports precede repair requests that explicitly identify damaged features of the standing figure.
A finished outline is followed by explicit celebration of the shared result.
Comparative membership explains attributed credit without establishing a judgment that available hands or space are inadequate for the desired work.
Comparative membership and an earlier location change do not establish shortage causing a new start.
A new location is announced without identifying prior erasure as its cause and the smaller loss occurs later.

how: The bare link supports pointing to another room but leaves negotiation, alliance, attack, and help unresolved beneath a deleted parent.
